pages.text: TM-192 2nd printing Signature Analysis Guide to CENTIPEDE™ For ROM versions -002 and -603 NOTE Before taking signatures on the Centipede™ Game PCB, examine the ROMs at locations D1, E1, F/H1, and J1 on your board. They will be marked with a part number such as 136001-208 or -308. The three digits at the end are important: they signify the version of the game program. Your PCB may have either all -200 series or -300 series ROMs (you can not mix the series in these four ROMs). The signatures are different for these two series of ROMs. Therefore, refer to the appropriate column under Signatures Should Be when taking signatures. A ATARI ING 1265 BORREGAS AVENUE PO.
